methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); pharmaceutical signals

pit_profile.why: 'is a global biopharmaceutical company whose mission is to discover, develop and deliver innovative medicines that help patients prevail over serious diseases.' BEAR.desc: EPS -46.3%/yr (worst year FY11-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +-1.3%/yr (FY22 guide + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY15 ex-FY17 ex-FY19 ex-FY20 ex-FY21 median

BULL.desc: EPS +4.9%/yr (FY11-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +48.6%/yr (best 2-yr run FY11-FY18 ex-FY15 ex-FY17); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: BMY (retrospective, 2022-02-04) ◎ ACCUMULATE — Ratio B 0.84x (70.8% downside to Bear $19 / +84.6% upside to Bull $120) | Adj composite 3.50 vs market 1.85: gap +1.65 [UNDERVALUED] | -3% above the EPP floor $67 (19x FY22E $3.52) | Conservative 2-yr case: +53.1% total (+26.5%/yr) | At 18.5x FY22E the 15% hurdle price $86 sits at or below the BASE case; U.S. revenues +10.9% in Q4 2021, forward revenues +1.3% (FY22 revenue guide); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
